title: Q4 launch sync

entries.text: Okay, let's start. Today: launch date, warehouse capacity, and who owns what.
Bang Na is at eighty-five percent. If orders grow twenty percent in launch week we run out of space around the twenty-eighth of October.
ถ้าอย่างนั้นเราต้องตัดสินใจเรื่องโกดังสำรองที่สมุทรปราการก่อนวันศุกร์ใช่ไหมคะ
Yes. The overflow space is about twelve hundred pallet positions with two weeks lead time. The other option is moving slow stock to a partner cross-dock.
I prefer the cross-dock first, it is cheaper. We rent the overflow space only if pre-orders pass eighteen thousand.
Agreed. We check the pre-order count on the twenty-third of October.
เรื่องวันเปิดตัวคือวันที่สามพฤศจิกายนเหมือนเดิมนะคะ ไม่เลื่อน
The launch date stays the third of November. Marketing wants the final delivery promise for the landing page by Monday.
Who writes the delivery promise? I think ops should draft it and then we review it.
Someone from ops, but I do not know who yet.
Fine. Can you update the launch checklist with the capacity numbers?
Will do, I will have it done by Friday.
และฉันจะขอให้ฝ่ายการเงินยืนยันงบค่าเช่าโกดังสำรองภายในวันศุกร์ค่ะ
Thanks everyone. Same time next week.

summary: The team reviewed Bang Na warehouse capacity for the 3 November launch. The warehouse is 85% full, and a 20% rise in launch-week orders would fill it around 28 October. They will move slow-moving stock to a partner cross-dock first and rent the Samut Prakan overflow space only if pre-orders pass 18,000 on 23 October.

decisions.text: Move slow-moving stock to a partner cross-dock first; rent the overflow space only if pre-orders pass 18,000.

open_questions.text: Who in ops drafts the delivery promise for the landing page?

action_items.title: Update the launch checklist with the capacity numbers
Confirm the overflow warehouse rental budget with finance
Draft the delivery promise for the landing page
